description: This file defines the ScreenPermissionService class responsible for managing screen permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve permissions for specific modules and actions based on user roles, accessing DAOs and entities related to screens and permissions.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionService
classes.description: Service class handling retrieval and management of screen permissions based on roles and module-actions.

methods.name: getScreenDao
methods.description: Returns the ScreenDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionDao
methods.description: Returns the ScreenPermissionDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for a given module, action URL, and roles, returning a ResourcePermission object.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Fetches the Screen entity for a given module and action URL.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Returns the current module and screen context as ModuleScreen.

methods.name: getCurrentScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the current screen entity based on the current module and screen context.
